summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for the creation of security interest over the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 15 as the Debenture Trustee acting for the benefit of the Debenture Holders. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation and perfection of a Security Interest in terms of the Debenture Trust Deed through the mortgage, hypothecation, charge, or assignment over rights, title, interest, claims, demands, benefits under, clearance, project documents, agreements, and approvals (with the exception of security over the fixed assets) of the Petitioner in favour of the Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (Respondent No. 15). Additionally, the Petitioner has requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the debenture facility. The Petitioner has made the following - _b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable) over all the assets including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 15/ Debenture Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 27.08.2025 (read with the Debenture Documents);_ - _c) approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment etc., over all the assets including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 15/ Debenture Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 27.08.2025 (read with the Debenture Documents) and for their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and substitutes thereof in respect to the Project; and_ - _d) pass any such other relief as the Hon'ble Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case "_ 6. As per the Debenture Trust Deed, the Petitioner has agreed to provide the following security to secure the Debenture-II: - c) Insurance Contracts and Insurance Proceeds (applicable only if the insured party for such policies is the Issuer). 8. The Petitioner has further submitted that in view of the provisions of subsections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, the Petitioner, as a licensee, cannot create a Security in favour of and/or for the benefit of the Debenture Holder pursuant to an amendment without the approval of this Commission. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking approval of the Commission for the creation of security by the Petitioner over the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 15 acting as the Debenture Trustee for the benefit of the Debenture Holders and for their subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage, to the extent described in this Petition to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 27.8.2025 aggregating to Rs. 180 crores. 9. The matter was admitted on 2.1.2026, and notices were issued to the parties to file their respective replies. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents. 10. During the hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner largely reiterated the submissions made in the Petition and further submitted that, vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) dated 2.1.2026, notice had been issued to all the Respondents; however, none of the Respondents had filed any reply, and the matter may be reserved for orders. Learned counsel for Respondent No. 6, i.e., DNH Power Distribution Corporation Limited (hereinafter referred to as “DNHPDCL”), submitted that creation of such security interest by the Petitioner ought not to affect the terms of the TSA in any manner and sought permission to file a brief reply to that effect. Learned counsel for the Respondent, MPPMCL, submitted that the Respondent does not wish to file any reply in the matter. In response, learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner is seeking approval for the creation of a security interest over its assets under the TSA. counsel for DNHPDCL. Upon consideration of the parties' submissions, the matter was reserved for orders. 12. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Petitioner had earlier availed financial assistance in the form of a loan facility from Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (Respondent No. 15) for an aggregate sanctioned amount of Rs. 2,450 crores towards financing the construction and development of the Project. In connection with the said facility, the Petitioner entered into a Debenture Trustee Agreement dated 28.11.2024 and a Debenture Trust Deed dated 13.12.2024. Pursuant to the said arrangement, the Petitioner approached this Commission seeking approval for the creation of a security interest over its assets in favour of Respondent No. 15. The Commission, vide order dated 12.6.2025 in Petition No. 309/MP/2025, granted such approval. interest over its assets in favour of the Debenture Trustee without the prior approval of this Commission. Accordingly, the present Petition has been filed seeking approval for creation of security over the Petitioner’s assets, in favour of Respondent No. 15, acting as Debenture Trustee for the benefit of the Debenture Holders and their respective transferees, assignees, and novatees, by way of hypothecation, assignment, or mortgage, as detailed in the Petition, to secure the Petitioner’s obligations under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 27.8.2025, for the loan facility aggregating Rs. 180 crores.
